# MEPcontent API (Trimble MEP content platform)

- **Product:** MEPcontent API (Trimble MEP content platform) (Construction software family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** API key in the ApiKey query parameter. Declared security schemes: none declared.
- **Access:** Manufacturers and partners issued an MEPcontent API key.
- **To call it you would need:** an MEPcontent API key for api.mepcontent.com; operations that require the key in the request are excluded as credential operations.
- **Documented servers:** `https://api.mepcontent.com`.
- **Definition:** [mepcontent](https://api.mepcontent.com/swagger/docs/v1) (CPWebApi, version v1). Documentation: https://api.mepcontent.com/Help.

## App

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/{version}/Mitsubishi/App/CheckArticleNumbers` | `reference` | Checks the availability of the article numbers. | version* (path); body: application/json, application/xml, text/json, text/xml |
| `POST` | `/{version}/Mitsubishi/App/CheckGtins` | `reference` | Checks the availability of the gtins. | version* (path); body: application/json, application/xml, text/json, text/xml |
| `POST` | `/{version}/Mitsubishi/App/Download` | `reference` | Downloads the files by codes (gtin or article number) and types (rfa,dwg). | version* (path); body: application/json, application/xml, text/json, text/xml |
| `POST` | `/{version}/Mitsubishi/App/GetThumbnails` | `reference` | Gets the thumbnails by article number or gtin. | version* (path); body: application/json, application/xml, text/json, text/xml |
| `POST` | `/{version}/Mitsubishi/App/GetThumbnailsLocalized` | `reference` | Gets the thumbnails by country, language and by codes (gtin or article number). | version* (path); body: application/json, application/xml, text/json, text/xml |
